name: @remonta/infra
description: How apps/api runs on Google Cloud Run: the stage table (lib/stages.ts) is the single source of truth; the Knative service definitions in cloudrun/ are rendered from it and checked for drift; cloudrun/bootstrap.sh prepares a fresh GCP project once (APIs, registry, service accounts, Workload Identity Federation for GitHub, empty secrets, log metrics, alerts). No IaC tool; gcloud and a rendered YAML.

scripts.quality: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run render:check
